reasons: Correctly classified as a deviation: the clause pairs Delaware law with New York courts, so it does not satisfy the preferred position (New York law + New York County courts) nor the fallback, which requires matching law and courts (Delaware/California law and courts, or England & Wales with London courts).

Redline is minimal and directionally right: substitutes 'Delaware' with 'New York' and tightens venue to 'New York County, New York', leaving the conflict-of-laws and submission language intact, consistent with the redline guidance to change only jurisdiction words and forum.

Comment is accurate, in the required tone and prefix, explains the change, cites the playbook position, offers the Delaware/California fallback, and appropriately raises the Section 8 AAA arbitration conflict without over-expanding the redline (no foreign seat, so no walk-away trigger).
Deterministic checks all pass; the 0.303 changed-character ratio reflects the required jurisdiction/venue substitution rather than an unnecessary rewrite.
